name: Suruchi (Hotel Padmini Nivas)
why_it_matters: Inside Padmini Nivas, an 1830s Rushbrooke Estate that became the Mussoorie home of the Maharani of Rajpipla. The hotel turned heritage in 1979 and Suruchi is its multi-cuisine pure-veg restaurant — Gujarati thalis are the family kitchen's specialty and a quiet alternative to the meat-heavy Mall Road circuit.
insider_tip: Sit on the Season Garden lawn in summer evenings — the open-air fast-food extension runs alongside Suruchi and looks out over the Doon valley.

name: Connaught Castle Restaurant
why_it_matters: Heritage hotel in English-style architecture sitting between Library and Picture Palace ends of the Mall, one minute off the Mall walkway. The in-house multi-cuisine restaurant runs round-the-clock with an outdoor coffee shop overlooking the Himalayan-and-town panorama.
insider_tip: Skip the indoor dining hall and ask for the outdoor coffee terrace — that is where the view actually lives. Open 24 hours, useful for late arrivals from Dehradun.
signature_address: The Mall, between Library Bazaar and Picture Palace, Mussoorie 248179

name: Whispering Windows
why_it_matters: Long-running Library Bazaar fixture at Gandhi Chowk with picture-window seating that looks down the Doon valley. One of the few Library-end places that runs live music in season alongside a full North Indian and tandoor menu.
insider_tip: Window seats are first-come, first-served and they're the entire reason to come — arrive before 7pm or eat at the bar bench instead.
signature_address: Library Bazaar, Gandhi Chowk, Mount View, The Mall, Mussoorie 248179

name: Café Library
signature_dish: Oreo thick shake with chocolate waffle
why_it_matters: Built into the Library Building itself at Gandhi Chowk — second-floor windows look directly over Library Chowk's main square. The most central caffeine stop on this end of the Mall, and the default meeting point when locals say 'see you at the Library'.
insider_tip: Rated 4.0 across 288 Zomato reviews — go for shakes and waffles, not the pasta. Window tables fill up by 4pm in season; come morning if you want the view without the queue.
signature_address: Shop No. 2, Library Building, Library Chowk / Gandhi Chowk, Mussoorie 248179

name: The Pebble Street
why_it_matters: Thirty to forty metres off Library Chowk on the Kempty Falls walking route, this small Gandhi-Chowk-side restaurant runs at 4.7 across 580+ Justdial ratings — unusually high for a hill-station mid-range. North Indian + Chinese + Mughlai done at small-kitchen prices most Mall Road places left behind a decade ago.
insider_tip: Open until 11:30pm, which is later than most Library-end places — useful after a Camel's Back walk that ran past sunset. Cash counter is faster than the table card machine.
signature_address: Gandhi Chowk, Library Bazaar, The Mall, Mussoorie 248179
